description: I hope you enjoyed this summer and our recent plume of fall colors. We certainly did. The legislature heads back into session on January 6th. In the meantime, I thought I’d alert you to some things happening during our “off season” specifically on the topic of Education Reform and Redistricting.

title: Education Reform Update — Rob North for a Change
